checks.result: PARTIAL - ET 378 correct; ET 375 and ET 381 misdescribed
checks.evidence: ET art. 378 (http://www.secretariasenado.gov.co/senado/basedoc/estatuto_tributario_pr015.html): 'Los agentes de retención en la fuente deberán expedir anualmente a los asalariados, un Certificado de Ingresos y Retenciones correspondiente al año gravable inmediatamente anterior, según el formato que prescriba la [DIAN]' - supports. ET art. 375 ('EFECTUAR LA RETENCIÓN'): 'Están obligados a efectuar la retención o percepción del tributo, los agentes de retención ...' - it imposes the obligation to withhold, it does NOT say the agent certifies the withholding practised. ET art. 381 ('CERTIFICADOS POR OTROS CONCEPTOS'): 'Cuando se trate de conceptos de retención diferentes de los originados en la relación laboral ...' - it covers non-labour withholding certificates and does not govern Form 220. Neither citation appears in the spec cell (M52 cites only the instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024), so the spec text is unaffected.

The 21330 sentence is conditional ('certified only where it carries the amount actually deducted ... and remitted to DIAN') and leaves the attribute to the WTC, consistent with 'the withholding-practised attribute of each comes from the WTC'; it does not classify the client WT. The 25834 statement ('is not withholding and is not certified') was already in the cell and in CO-DIAN-001 M191 / CO-DIAN-002 M23, A40, C5, and rests on the WT's own name ('Hypothetical'); nothing new is classified and no client WT is mapped to the master WTC.

Official Form 350 instructivo, Res. DIAN 000031 of 29 Feb 2024 (https://normograma.com/documentospdf/PDF/R_DIAN_0031_2024.pdf, 'INSTRUCTIVO PARA EL DILIGENCIAMIENTO DE LA DECLARACION DE RETENCION EN LA FUENTE', PDF page 5): '93. Rentas de trabajo: escriba en esta casilla el total de las retenciones en la fuente realizadas en el mes utilizando la tabla a que se refiere el articulo 383 del E.T., por pagos o abonos en cuenta efectuados a personas naturales por concepto de salarios, comisiones, prestaciones sociales, ...' and '94. Rentas de pensiones: escriba en esta casilla el valor retenido por los pagos mensuales que excedieron las mil (1000) UVT conforme a lo senalado en el numeral 5 del articulo 206 del E.T., por concepto de pensiones de jubilacion, invalidez, vejez, de sobrevivientes y sobre riesgos laborales, ...'. Form 220 casilla 60 (Res. DIAN 000022/2024 instructivo, quoted in pass 1): 'retenciones ... practicadas al trabajador o pensionado'. Specs: 004 M52 sources casilla 60 from 2552 + 21129 + 21140 + 21155, and 004 M41 says 'the withholding on pension income (21140 ...) feeds casilla 60'. 005 M37 defines numeral 29 as withholding on 'work or pension income', sourced from 'the separate withholding wage types for terminations, retirees and equity awards'; 005 Payroll Scope Summary C50 gives pensioners a record with numeral 29. NE: Res. DIAN 000013/2021 art. 1 num. 5 (local copy raw/docs/oficiais/CO/2026-10-21-Res-DIAN-0013-2021-normograma.htm): 'Beneficiario del pago: ... las personas naturales vinculadas mediante una relacion laboral o legal y reglamentaria y los pensionados a cargo del empleador'. NIE177 therefore includes withholding on pensions paid by the employer, and the 001 Payroll Scope Summary also says the document supports 'pensions borne by the employer'. CO-DIAN-002: M23 says 'Withholding on the pension income the employer pays itself (WT 21140 ..., WT 21155 ...) is not reported here: it goes to casilla 94'. M25 defines casilla 94 as 21140 + 21155 and states 'Casilla 93 plus casilla 94 must reconcile to the sum of RetencionFuente (NIE177)'. The same appears in Report Matrix A40, Payroll Scope Summary C28, Population Rules C5/C6/D15/C29 and Example Analysis D15/C38. 'Casillas 93 plus 94' is therefore the correct population target for casilla 60, numeral 29 and NIE177.

Searched every string cell of the six 05-final specs for casilla 93/94, 21330, 25832, 25833, 25834, 21140, 21155, NIE177, RetencionFuente, casilla 60 and numeral 29. CO-PILA-003 and CO-CESANTIAS-006: no hits. Once the maps are applied, no cell reconciles casilla 60, numeral 29 or NIE177 to casilla 93 alone. The remaining references to casilla 93 alone are acceptable: 001 Example Analysis B46 '-> Form 350 casilla 93' (worked example of one employee with no pension), and 002 Report Matrix A34, Payroll Scope Summary C25/C32 and Example Analysis D14/C28, which describe casilla 93 itself. (a) DEFECT - CO-DIAN-001 M191, which is also in the map: after the change the cell reconciles NIE177 to casillas 93 plus 94. Its own definition ('Withholding at source sobre employment income') and source list (2552, 21330, 21129, 25832, 25833) leave out the pension withholding WTs 21140 / 21155. Those WTs feed casilla 94, and NIE177 carries them for pensions paid by the employer (Res. 000013/2021 art. 1 num. 5). Read literally, M191 makes SUM(NIE177) differ from 93 + 94 whenever casilla 94 is not zero. The cell also contains the Spanish word 'sobre' in an English sentence (already there before this change). (b) CO-DIAN-002 M23 says 'Withholding deducted on WT 21129 (Terminations), 25832 ... and 25833 ... enters in the month it is practised ... the wage types named here are the ones so classified', and Population Rules C5 says 'plus the withholding deducted on 21129 ..., 25832 ... and 25833'. Both present 25832 / 25833 as already classified as practised, while 004 M52 and the new 001 M191 make them depend on the WTC attribute. The meaning is compatible ('withholding deducted on'), but the wording differs. Align it in a later map, e.g. drop 'the wage types named here are the ones so classified' and add 'where the WTC classifies them as withholding actually deducted' for 25832 / 25833. (c) CO-DIAN-004 M41 names only 21140 as the pension withholding that feeds casilla 60, while M52 names both 21140 and 21155 (minor omission). The 21330 rule is the same in substance in 001 M191, 002 M23 / A40 / C5 and the new 004 M52. 25834 is 'not withholding / out of scope' in every spec. 005 names none of these WTs and states only the general rule, which is consistent.
